published_output_convention: Section 7.1: boxes within each label are stably sorted by x1; implemented by the within-class x-order check.

user_experiment_constraints.tuner: existing SFT LoRA rank 16, alpha 32 and its 1000 coordinate rows

single_gpu_execution.note: Chunk size controls memory only; all 256 rewards are collected before advantage normalization and one optimizer update. The paper uses 256 GPUs, accumulation 1, ZeRO-2.

unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_count_agreement: Existing adaptation uses min(predicted,reference)/max(predicted,reference); grounding formula not published.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_matching: Existing adaptation uses class-aware maximum-cardinality matching; exact matching/tie-breaking not published.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_matched_iou: Existing adaptation averages matches at IoU >= 0.5; exact averaging convention not published.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_duplicates: Existing adaptation uses same-class IoU >= 0.9 and fraction of later duplicate predictions; threshold and normalization not published.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_oversize: Existing adaptation uses area > 0.8 of image without GT support condition; grounding threshold and definition not published.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_format: Existing adaptation gives 0 to both rewards on globally invalid Rex format; paper specifies a strict format component but not full parser/error gating.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.empty_ground_truth: Existing adaptation assigns 1 only to valid empty prediction; paper set reward excludes empty reference sets.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_order_score: The within-label x1 ordering convention is published. Existing adaptation uses an all-or-nothing ordering score; exact score normalization/partial-credit rules are not published.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.rollout_sampling_and_length: Current experimental values temperature=1, top_p=1, top_k=0, completion=1024, max_length=4096; no matching RL table values located.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.training_duration: Current experiment has one epoch over the fixed 10000-image subset; RL epoch/step budget not stated in Table 11. 10000 is not divisible by 32, so treatment of the final 16 prompts also needs confirmation.
